payout_quote: People who have received anthrax vaccine often have special antibodies in their plasma. These antibodies are needed to produce a life-saving medication called anthrax immune globulin (AIG). ... *Participating donors earn over $1400 for the 3 immunizations and the 8 AIG plasma donations… **and this is in addition to thousands of dollars in Normal donor fees!***
timing: Paid per immunization and per AIG donation via prepaid Visa; totals over $1400 across the program
eligibility: TheraPlas donor; provide records of 2+ prior anthrax immunizations (military/VA records) OR receive 3 anthrax immunizations in their office over six months; donate AIG plasma twice weekly for 4 weeks after 2-week wait; standard donor screening applies
steps: Provide records showing 2+ prior anthrax immunizations (military/VA records work)
Become a TheraPlas donor and donate as a regular donor meanwhile
Receive the anthrax vaccine booster/series in their office (3 immunizations over six months if starting fresh)
Wait 2 weeks, then donate AIG plasma twice weekly for 4 weeks (8 donations)
Earn over $1400 across the immunizations + 8 AIG donations, on top of normal donor fees
catches: Only for people with anthrax vaccination history (mostly military/veterans) or willing to get the anthrax vaccine series.
Requires 3 in-office immunizations over six months if starting from scratch — this is a long program, not quick cash.
Still requires full donor screening; not everyone qualifies medically.
biggest_catch: This is a months-long immunization program paying $1400+ total — great if you're a veteran with anthrax records, not a casual side hustle for everyone else.

repeatable.note: One-time specialty program per donor (immunization series + 8 AIG donations). Regular plasma donations continue repeatable weekly alongside.

maximize: If you have military anthrax vaccine records, pull them from your branch/VA portal before your first visit — that skips the six-month immunization build-up. Donate as a regular donor the whole time so you're stacking normal fees AND the $1400+ AIG payout.
